english.title: Vehicle enter motorway at prohibited place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[moved]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), onto the **(..SPECIFY DIRECTION..) carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), where there was a traffic sign indicating that there was no entry to the carriageway
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
